description: This file contains acceptance tests for the Projects module, including viewing the list view and creating a project within a SuiteCRM application. It uses the Codeception testing framework with Faker for generating test data.

classes.name: ProjectsCest
classes.description: Acceptance test class for the Projects module, including setup and scenarios for viewing and creating projects.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Setup method that initializes Faker data generator and seeds it with a random seed before each test.

methods.name: testScenarioViewProjectsModule
methods.description: Test scenario to verify that the admin user can view the Projects module list view.

methods.name: testScenarioCreateProject
methods.description: Test scenario to verify that the admin user can create and delete a project with generated data.
